patch_description: This variant strengthens the edge-traffic discount to 0.85 while retaining demand-aware direct-link rewards and node-pressure discounts. Two-hop rewards are reduced when either component link already carries substantial direct demand, or when the intermediate node has high incident demand. The un-clamped discount preserves distinctions between paths of different congestion levels. The number of quadratic terms remains at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\), within the stated limit.
